findings.views: Adult, child and infant palm detail

findings.observation: The bent wrist has a continuous silhouette and no visible hole, cap edge or new bulge. The hidden-end correction does not visibly enlarge the wrist compared with the intermediate candidate.
Both arms and hands retain the baseline framing and readable poses.
The white wrist and palm form a continuous silhouette; separated fingers and gray palm creases remain distinguishable.
No new wrist gap is visible. The white support hand still merges with the white face at contact, limiting contact clarity; this existing contrast limitation remains outside the wrist change.
